purpose: Compact executable canon for Doré co-writing. This is not a style imitation prompt.
rule: Diagnostics expose risk; they never mechanically rewrite authorial prose. Semantic judgment decides whether a flagged form is earned.

compositionGrowth.rule: Grow the article in ordered layers. Establish the structural skeleton first so thesis, route, scale, and destination cannot drift; add flesh through evidence, history, archaeology, objects, scenes, data, and stories; articulate musculature by shaping relations, tension, pacing, callbacks, and causal movement; extend nerves and vessels through fine connections among Scripture, original language, geography, material culture, reception, and human detail; develop texture through precise facts, memorable side-material, measurements, names, disputes, and sensory particulars; add skin last as the finished prose surface—voice, diction, paragraph rhythm, transitions, restraint, and readability. Later layers enrich rather than replace or distort the skeleton.
compositionGrowth.chinese: 骨架 → 肉 → 肌肉 → 神經與血管 → 肌理 → 皮膚。先定文章骨架，鎖住主題、路線、尺度與終點，使寫作不偏；再用史料、考古、器物、場景、數據、故事長出肉；細描材料之間的關係、張力、節奏、回聲與因果，形成肌肉；以經文、原文、地理、物質文化、接受史與人的細節建立神經與血管；用尺寸、名字、爭論、旁逸談資與感官細節形成肌理；最後才處理語氣、字詞、段落呼吸、轉接、節制與可讀性這層皮膚。後一層只能使前一層更完整，不得把既定骨架寫偏。

evolutionCorpus.policy: Real writing may train Doré through versioned evolution episodes. An episode is evidence for learning, not automatic Core canon. Promote transferable grammar only after cross-work validation; keep work-specific arcs in work profiles.

validationTargets: 《神很遠，神很近｜天國語言極簡史》
